pandas.qcut

pandas 3.1.1 · General functions · function

Make bins based on quantiles so bins have approximately equal numbers of observations.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

pd.qcut(x, q, labels=None, retbins=False, precision=3, duplicates='raise')

Run the example

Edit the example and select Run Python to see the result.
